scope: real PS Vita hardware startup of private full-engine build 00.03
result: crashed before selector because the port misinterpreted vitaGL's return value

root_cause.details: vglInitExtended returns a framebuffer-resolution fallback flag, not a success flag. GL_FALSE is the normal result when 960x544 is accepted. The port treated GL_FALSE as initialization failure and returned 0, causing VitaEngine.main to throw Native startup failed.
root_cause.vitaGL_behavior: vglInitWithCustomSizes initializes res_fallback to GL_FALSE, sets it GL_TRUE only when requested width/height exceed the maximum framebuffer resolution, and returns res_fallback.
